title: allium atrorubens subsp. inyonis
intro: Allium atrorubens subsp. inyonis, commonly known as the Inyo onion or desert onion, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. The Inyo onion has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as colds, coughs, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, demulcent, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it effective in soothing irritated mucous membranes and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Inyo onion include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
